name: Qwen3-4B
african_language_support: Multilingual pretraining reported on model card, but Krio (kri) support is UNVERIFIED. Do not treat headline language counts as Krio coverage.
notes: Instruction/chat variant of Qwen3-4B; requires tokenizer fertility audit and benchmark.

name: Qwen3-4B-Base
african_language_support: Used in AfriqueLLM (arXiv 2601.06395, ACL 2026). Krio not among AfriqueLLM languages; Qwen3 Krio coverage is UNVERIFIED.
notes: Source: arXiv 2601.06395. Pretrained base checkpoint; verify Krio tokenizer efficiency.

name: Qwen3-8B-Base
african_language_support: Used in AfriqueLLM (arXiv 2601.06395, ACL 2026). Krio not among AfriqueLLM languages; Qwen3 Krio coverage is UNVERIFIED.
notes: Source: arXiv 2601.06395. Larger Qwen3 variant.

name: Gemma-3 1B
african_language_support: Compact Gemma-3 pretrained checkpoint. Krio is NOT officially supported; do not treat headline multilingual claims as Krio support.
notes: Lightweight 1B candidate suitable for low-VRAM QLoRA experimentation.

name: Gemma-3 4B
african_language_support: Used in AfriqueLLM (arXiv 2601.06395, ACL 2026) for African language adaptation. Krio not among the AfriqueLLM languages; base model has no verified Krio data.
notes: Smaller scale; suitable for resource-constrained training. Verify Gemma Terms of Use for research vs commercial use.

name: Gemma-3 12B
african_language_support: Used in AfriqueLLM (arXiv 2601.06395, ACL 2026) for African language adaptation. Krio not among the AfriqueLLM languages; base model has no verified Krio data.
notes: Larger Gemma-3 variant. Requires 24 GB VRAM for QLoRA. Source: arXiv 2601.06395.

name: Llama-3.2 1B
african_language_support: Krio is NOT among Llama 3.2's officially supported languages (English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, Thai).
notes: Compact 1B baseline; English-lexified transfer to Krio must be measured empirically.

name: Llama-3.2 3B
african_language_support: Krio is NOT among Llama 3.2's officially supported languages (English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, Thai).
notes: 3B baseline candidate for LoRA/QLoRA adaptation; requires custom Krio evaluation.

name: Llama-3.1-8B
african_language_support: Primarily English-focused. Used as the base for AfriqueLLM (arXiv 2601.06395, ACL 2026) which performed continued pretraining across 20 African languages (~26B tokens). Krio not among the AfriqueLLM languages; plain Llama-3.1-8B has no Krio data.
krio_tokenizer_coverage: unknown – needs measurement; English-centric tokenizer may fragment Krio
notes: Strong baseline; widely tested for African language adaptation (AfriqueLLM 2026). QLoRA at 4-bit runs on 16 GB VRAM. Tokenizer fertility must be measured first.

name: Aya-23 8B
african_language_support: No sub-Saharan African languages. The 23 languages are: Arabic, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Czech, Dutch, English, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese. Arabic is the only African-spoken language. Krio is NOT covered.
notes: Despite the name, Aya-23 does not cover sub-Saharan Africa. CC-BY-NC-4.0 licence restricts commercial use.

name: Tiny Aya Base
african_language_support: Pretrained on 70 languages with 8k context. African language excerpt: am, ha, ig, mg, sn, sw, wo, xh, yo, zu. No kri seen on model card.
notes: Base pretrained checkpoint of Tiny Aya (3.35B). Gated download, non-commercial research licence.

name: Tiny Aya Global
african_language_support: Instruction-tuned global checkpoint on 70 languages. Krio (kri) coverage is unverified on model card.
notes: Instruction-tuned global variant of Tiny Aya (3.35B). Gated download, non-commercial.

name: Tiny Aya Earth
african_language_support: Specialised checkpoint targeting languages across Africa and West Asia. Krio (kri) coverage is unconfirmed on published card.
notes: Regional focus on African and West Asian languages (3.35B). Gated download, non-commercial.

name: Aya Expanse 8B
african_language_support: Reported as 23 languages expanded instruction tuning. Krio coverage is unverified on model card.
notes: Larger 8B Aya Expanse model. Requires 16 GB VRAM for QLoRA.

name: AfroLLaMA / AfroLlama_V1
african_language_support: Reported as African-language LoRA continued-pretraining on ~6 African languages. Krio (kri) is NOT listed in published descriptions.
krio_tokenizer_coverage: unknown – Krio not in reported training languages
notes: Entry requires manual verification of exact base model, parameters, licence, and language list.

name: mT5-base
african_language_support: Trained on mC4 corpus; Krio (kri) is NOT explicitly listed and coverage is unverified.
notes: Encoder-decoder architecture for sequence-to-sequence translation experiments only.

name: NLLB-200 Distilled 600M
african_language_support: Krio (kri_Latn) is NOT in the NLLB-200 language list on the official model card. Languages of the region it does list include Wolof, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, Twi — verify before use.
notes: Encoder-decoder translation baseline for other languages only. Card says research model, not for production; CC-BY-NC-4.0.

name: Whisper Small
african_language_support: Krio (kri) is NOT in OpenAI Whisper's pretrained language list; requires supervised fine-tuning on verified Sierra Leonean Krio speech.
notes: ASR baseline architecture for comparison against w2v-BERT / MMS models.

name: DONDO w2v-BERT Sierra Leone ASR
african_language_support: Multilingual w2v-BERT 2.0 CTC checkpoint covering Krio (kri), Mende (men), Temne (tem), and English (en), trained primarily on read religious speech. Out-of-domain conversational and agricultural WER is unverified.
notes: Candidate Sierra Leone ASR model (arXiv:2607.21540); requires independent benchmark evaluation.

name: DONDO w2v-BERT Mende ASR
african_language_support: Monolingual Mende (men) w2v-BERT 2.0 checkpoint. Trained primarily on read religious speech; reported in-domain WER 12.9 % (Mende) — self-reported, in-domain.
notes: Monolingual Mende ASR checkpoint from KhayaAI DONDO collection; requires independent benchmark evaluation.

name: DONDO w2v-BERT Temne ASR
african_language_support: Monolingual Temne (tem) w2v-BERT 2.0 checkpoint. Trained primarily on read religious speech; reported in-domain WER 10.6 % (Temne) — self-reported, in-domain.
notes: Monolingual Temne ASR checkpoint from KhayaAI DONDO collection; requires independent benchmark evaluation.

name: MMS-TTS Baseline
african_language_support: Meta MMS covers 1,100+ languages primarily from religious recordings; Sierra Leonean Krio naturalness and licence terms must be verified.
notes: TTS architecture candidate; requires studio-grade consented speech before adaptation.
